# bank-account.close

Close a company's bank account; it takes no more deposits.

**Who may call:** the owner of its account.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 800ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| account | bank-account.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| account | bank-account.id |

## Move

`close`: from open to closed, emitting BankAccountClosed.

## Steps

- `bank-account.close.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| BankAccountNotOpen | 40 | BA-900 | the bank-account is in a state close can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its account.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account closes

Starts from the world `two bank accounts`.

- **Bo can't close it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends account the world's account, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada closes it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, and gets back the world's account.
- **it can't be closed twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, and is refused with BankAccountNotOpen, BA-900, carrying state `closed`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bank-account close --account <account>
```

HTTP: `POST /bank-account/close` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.bank-account.close(payload)`.

# bank-account.get

Read one bank-account by its id: company, business, accountName, currency, bankName, accountNumber, routingNumber, state.

## Payload

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| company | bank-account.company |  |
| business | bank-account.business | The company's approved KYB the account is opened on. |
| accountName | bank-account.accountName | What the company calls the account (ERPNext's `account_name`). |
| currency | bank-account.currency | The currency it takes deposits in. |
| bankName | bank-account.bankName | The bank that holds it, as Bridge names it. |
| accountNumber | bank-account.accountNumber | Its account number, or IBAN, as Bridge gives it. |
| routingNumber | bank-account.routingNumber | Its routing number, or BIC, as Bridge gives it. |
| state | text |  |

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account closes

Starts from the world `two bank accounts`.

- **Ada reads it back with the deposit details she was given.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's account, and gets back [the world's company, the world's business, `Operating`, `USD`, the world's bankName, the world's accountNumber, the world's routingNumber, `open`].
- **the new account is a different one.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's account, and gets back `open`.
- **and the old one stays closed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's account, and gets back [the world's company, the world's business, `Operating`, `USD`, the world's bankName, the world's accountNumber, the world's routingNumber, `closed`].
- **the euro account is untouched, with the details it was opened with.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's payroll, and gets back [the world's company, the world's business, `Payroll`, `EUR`, the world's payrollBankName, the world's payrollAccountNumber, the world's payrollRoutingNumber, `open`].

### bridge: a reopened account is its own

Starts from the world `a reopened account`.

- **the new account reads back with the details its opening answered.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's account, and gets back [the world's company, the world's business, `Operating`, `USD`, the world's bankName, the world's accountNumber, the world's routingNumber, `open`].
- **the old one is closed, and keeps its own number.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's old, and gets back [the world's oldAccountNumber, `closed`].

### bridge: open a bank account

Starts from the world `kyb approved`.

- **Bo can't read it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's account, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **it reads back as the second account, not the first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's account, and gets back [the world's company, the world's business, `Payroll`, `EUR`, `open`] and gets back an answer matching `^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{10,30}$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bank-account get --id <id>
```

HTTP: `POST /bank-account/get` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.bank-account.get(payload)`.

- `holiday.add.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| HolidayOutsideList | 42 | HD-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying fromDate, toDate |
| HolidayDateTaken | 41 | HD-001 | another holiday holds this holiday list and holiday date; by the rule holiday.oneHolidayPerDay, carrying holidayDate |

## Worked examples

### a one-day list

Starts from the world `a one-day list`.

- **the day before its only day is outside it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-08-13`, description `Too early`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2028-08-14`, toDate `2028-08-14`.
- **so is the day after.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-08-15`, description `Too late`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2028-08-14`, toDate `2028-08-14`.
- **that day is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-08-14`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-08-14`.

### add holidays

Starts from the world `a holiday list`.

- **Ada adds the list's first day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-01-01`, description `New Year's Day`, and gets back [`1`] and gets back an answer matching `^hol_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **the same day can't be added twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-01-01`, description `Again`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2027-01-01`.
- **a day before the list starts is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2026-12-31`, description `Too early`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`.
- **so is a day after it ends.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-01-01`, description `Too late`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`.

- **the list's last day may be a holiday too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-12-31`, description `New Year's Eve`, and gets back [`2`].

### every weekday

Starts from the world `a leap fortnight`.

- **the leap day is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-02-29`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-02-29`.
- **the first of March is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-03-01`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-03-01`.
- **the second of March is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-03-02`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-03-02`.
- **the fourth of March is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-03-04`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-03-04`.
